before: Character-style headers can select the wrong source occurrence. Some grouped pictures and mixed table borders use unsupported visual geometry.
after: Headers use source-owned page ranges and active occurrences. Grouped pictures refuse unsupported visual properties. Modern mixed table borders retain their full-stroke geometry.
reason: These changes affect read-only projection and layout. They do not change tree operations, saved OOXML, shared identities, or synchronization messages.
